Name: First Whistle
Description: Play a match to the final whistle.
Notes: THE ROOT OF EVERYTHING. Read the note at the top of achievement_book.gd: nothing in this game is available until an achievement hands it over. `Unlocks` is what this one hands over - a semicolon-separated list, in the same words the rest of the game uses. `Needs` is the ordinary condition language: count:x>=n, flag:y, unlocked:z, joined with semicolons.

Name: First Win
Notes: `Reward` is anything else that should happen, in the same words a Progression row's Do column uses. Coins, a flag, a story scene. THIS ROW SAID `give:coins+25` AND DID NOTHING FOR MONTHS - there is no `give` verb; it is `count:`. The loud-unknown-action guard added last round is what found it, on the first soak after it went in.

Name: Star Collector
Description: Own three Star Players of the same class.
Notes: THE GATE ON THE TALENT TREE. Three Stars of one class opens the Emblem section - but the Emblems have to be unlocked HERE first, which is what this row does. It waits on a FLAG rather than a counter because owning three of a kind is a fact about your squad, not a thing that happens; the team builder sets that flag when the tree lands. Until then this one is unearnable on purpose.

Name: A Second Vat
Reward: announce:A second vat is for sale at the Club House.
Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony): AN ACHIEVEMENT ONLY GRANTS THE RIGHT TO BUY AN UPGRADE. This row used to hand the vat over for free (count:batches_cooling+1); now it puts the vat on sale at the Club House - the row with Achievement = second_vat in data/Upgrades.csv. To hand an upgrade out FREE again, put its Effect back in Reward. THE SHAPE FOR THE WHOLE BREWERY: the basic foundation is free and everything that makes it bigger is earned. The Cooling cellar starts with ONE vat - its Batches column - and this Reward adds another. Copy this row for a third, or for batches_boiling, batches_malthouse, any section you like. No code and no new column, and the Brewery screen counts the vats for you.

Name: A Third Vat
Reward: announce:A third vat is for sale at the Club House.
Notes: ROUND AN: puts the third vat on sale at the Club House (data/Upgrades.csv) instead of giving it. The same row again. tools/brewery_check.gd measures what each one is worth: one vat is 24 bottles a season, two is 48, three is 54 - because by then hops are the limit and the Traveling Brewer is the answer rather than a fourth vat.

Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony, 8 Oct). Opens retraining at the Training Ground (Training.csv row quereinsteiger, Kind retrain). Twenty matches is a placeholder - move Needs to whatever should earn it.
